metadata.title: On filtration formula and nodal sets in min-max theory
metadata.abstract:
Let $(M^{n+1},g)$ be a closed smooth Riemannian manifold, and let \[ 0=\lambda_0\leq\lambda_1\leq\ldots \] be the spectrum of the Laplace-Beltrami operator, with corresponding real eigenfunctions $\{\phi_j\}_{j\geq0}$. Let $\{\omega_p(M,g)\}_{p\geq1}$ denote Gromov's volume spectrum. In 2014, Marques-Neves conjectured that the sweepout generated by the nodal sets of $\phi_0,\ldots,\phi_p$ is asymptotically optimal for $\omega_p(M,g)$ as $p	o\infty$. We show that this conjecture is false in every dimension, even for positively curved real-analytic metrics. Nevertheless, we show that a less rigid notion of nodal sweepouts recovers the volume spectrum. Let \[ E_N(M,g):=\operatorname{span}\{\phi_0,\ldots,\phi_N\}, \qquad a_N\in H^1 igl(\mathbb P(E_N(g));\mathbb Z_2 igr) \] be the generator, and for $p\geq1$ define \[ \mathcal N_p^N(g) := \left\{ \Psi \mid X	ext{ is a finite complex},\ \Psi\in C igl(X,\mathbb P(E_N(g)) igr),\ \Psi^*(a_N^p)
eq0 ight\}. \] We define the nodal $(p,N)$-width by \[ 
u_p^N(M,g) := \inf_{\Psi\in\mathcal N_p^N(g)} \sup_{x\in\operatorname{dmn}(\Psi)} \mathcal H_g^{n} igl(\{\Psi_x=0\} igr). \] We prove the following filtration formula \[ \omega_p(M,g) = \lim_{N	o\infty}
u_p^N(M,g) \] for every $p\geq1$. We state several questions on nodal geometry and min-max theory.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 极小超曲面宽度的谱逼近与反例
analysis.workSummary: 作者在每个维数构造反例，否定用前 p+1 个特征函数的零集扫掠普遍渐近实现第 p 个宽度的猜想，反例可有正曲率且度量实解析。另允许在更大谱空间中选取检测相应上同调幂的扫掠，证明固定 p 时所得宽度随谱截断增大收敛到真正宽度。
analysis.breakthrough: 区分受限零集族的渐近失效与扩大谱空间后的固定阶宽度逼近。
analysis.limitations: 反例的 p 增长与正面结论中固定 p、谱截断 N 趋于无穷是不同极限，不能混为一谈。
analysis.priorityReason: 区分受限零集族的渐近失效与扩大谱空间后的固定阶宽度逼近。
